final_message: Parsed the log file by reading each entry and filtering only ERROR and CRITICAL levels (case insensitive). Converted timestamps to UTC ISO format, extracted service, level (upper case), message, and the last line of traceback as exception or null if none. Calculated repeat_count including repeated message lines. Summed counts by service. Wrote the structured JSON output to workspace/errors.json following Acme log-triage conventions.

checks.name: rule_service_names
checks.detail: RULE: service names in the output are lower-case with '-' replaced by '_' (payment-service -> payment_service).

checks.name: rule_sorted_errors
checks.detail: RULE: `errors` is sorted by service, then by timestamp_utc, ascending.

checks.name: rule_schema_header
checks.detail: RULE: the top-level object has "schema_version": 2 and "generated_by": "log-triage".
